newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Fernandez confirms three cabinet changes.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Fernandez confirms three cabinet changes.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez confirmed on Friday that two officials in his team were leaving and a third was being shuffled to another sector.
Fernandez told reporters the head of the taxation office, Carlos Sanchez, will soon leave the economic team and that Guillermo Calvo, an aide to the minister on macroeconomic affairs, had quit.
Fernandez, appointed in late July, said both officials had been expected to remain with the new minister during his first few weeks only.
Sanchez was former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo's deputy in the ministry.

Fernandez added that Jose Maria Farre, deputy secretary of public finances, will become the minister's adviser. He will be replaced as deputy secretary by Guillermo Rodriguez, who was Farre's adviser.
